what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Chad in all host countries combined: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 17111 asylum seekers from Chad.
The Central African Republic hosts the largest share, 46.1%, followed by Cameroon, Canada and the Niger.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Chad in periods from 1997, most recently with CCMSR and FACT in 2020 to 2021 and with CCMSR in 2023.
It also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group in Chad in 2015 and from 2017 to 2022.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 2000 at 2422 asylum seekers.
The figure was at its highest, 40745, at the end of 2023, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2023 and 2024.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals of asylum seekers summed over every host country; refugees from Chad are counted separately.
